source_snapshot.title: Dubai villa building permits for Emiratis now take five working days under self-licensing scheme
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: The Dubai Municipality revealed that it approved 8,251 transactions within the ‘Self-License for Citizens’ Villas’ initiative during eight months, from February to September 2026, noting that the initiative has contributed to reducing the time required to complete transactions to five working days, with a decrease of 37.5%. This enhances the speed of completing construction procedures and supports its efforts aimed at providing integrated housing facilities and solutions for citizen families, and enhancing the flexibility of housing procedures and services, thus saving time, effort and costs, and meeting the requirements of citizens to obtain suitable housing of high quality. The Municipality explained that the rate of approval and acceptance of transactions has increased to 81%, while subsequent investigation work resulted in the detection of 36 violations, all of which were corrected. The authority noted that it intends to launch initiatives soon that will allow the design and preparation of house drawings within minutes, using modern technologies, which will contribute to simplifying the housing design process and accelerating the procedures for approving plans. Dubai Municipality confirmed that the Self-Licensing for Citizens’ Villas initiative aims to facilitate procedures for customers and reduce the time required to complete transactions, by enabling accredited engineering consulting offices to obtain a building permit when applying for the transaction, thus providing a more flexible journey in the procedures for licensing private residential villas. It indicated that the number of transactions that were approved, from the launch of the initiative in February until September 2026, amounted to 8,251 transactions, while the transaction completion time decreased from eight days to five working days, a decrease of 37.5%, and the approval rate increased from 72.9% to 81.59%. It noted that the application of the post-investigation mechanism resulted in the detection of 36 violations, stressing that all the violations that were detected were corrected, reflecting the continued monitoring of transactions after the issuance of the license, in parallel with accelerating the accreditation procedures. As part of its drive to develop the construction and urban planning system, Dubai Municipality affirmed its commitment to developing the future of the construction, infrastructure, urban development and industrial innovation sectors, and enhancing Dubai’s position as a global centre for the construction industry, by working to build a more integrated, intelligent and efficient system, paving the way for artificial intelligence, robotics, advanced manufacturing and green sustainability, in addition to relying on data in decision-making and urban planning. The Municipality stated that it is looking forward to a future where home design becomes simpler, easier, and more responsive to individual needs, through initiatives it is currently working on and will launch soon. It explained that these initiatives will allow a number of drawings to be completed within a few minutes, with the aim of providing a smoother approval process. Dubai Municipality recently announced the accreditation of a number of engineering consultancy offices to provide self-licensing services for building citizens' villas, with the aim of raising the efficiency of private residential villa licensing procedures, and simplifying and accelerating the steps of issuing building permits directly from the offices without the need for prior review by the municipality's engineers, which contributes to facilitating the journey of building a home, and saving time and effort for citizens. Self-licensing is an important step to facilitate the journey of building homes and villas for citizens, and reflects Dubai’s keenness to meet the aspirations and needs of citizens, develop a modern and sustainable residential environment, and shorten the procedures related to building and construction, by speeding up the licensing process and issuing the license. Dubai: The Dubai Municipality revealed that it approved 8,251 transactions within the ‘Self-License for Citizens’ Villas’ initiative during eight months, from February to September 2026, noting that the initiative has contributed to reducing the time required to complete transactions to five working days, with a decrease of 37.5%.

This enhances the speed of completing construction procedures and supports its efforts aimed at providing integrated housing facilities and solutions for citizen families, and enhancing the flexibility of housing procedures and services, thus saving time, effort and costs, and meeting the requirements of citizens to obtain suitable housing of high quality.

The Municipality explained that the rate of approval and acceptance of transactions has increased to 81%, while subsequent investigation work resulted in the detection of 36 violations, all of which were corrected.

The authority noted that it intends to launch initiatives soon that will allow the design and preparation of house drawings within minutes, using modern technologies, which will contribute to simplifying the housing design process and accelerating the procedures for approving plans.

Dubai Municipality confirmed that the Self-Licensing for Citizens’ Villas initiative aims to facilitate procedures for customers and reduce the time required to complete transactions, by enabling accredited engineering consulting offices to obtain a building permit when applying for the transaction, thus providing a more flexible journey in the procedures for licensing private residential villas.

It indicated that the number of transactions that were approved, from the launch of the initiative in February until September 2026, amounted to 8,251 transactions, while the transaction completion time decreased from eight days to five working days, a decrease of 37.5%, and the approval rate increased from 72.9% to 81.59%.

It noted that the application of the post-investigation mechanism resulted in the detection of 36 violations, stressing that all the violations that were detected were corrected, reflecting the continued monitoring of transactions after the issuance of the license, in parallel with accelerating the accreditation procedures.

As part of its drive to develop the construction and urban planning system, Dubai Municipality affirmed its commitment to developing the future of the construction, infrastructure, urban development and industrial innovation sectors, and enhancing Dubai’s position as a global centre for the construction industry, by working to build a more integrated, intelligent and efficient system, paving the way for artificial intelligence, robotics, advanced manufacturing and green sustainability, in addition to relying on data in decision-making and urban planning.

The Municipality stated that it is looking forward to a future where home design becomes simpler, easier, and more responsive to individual needs, through initiatives it is currently working on and will launch soon.
It explained that these initiatives will allow a number of drawings to be completed within a few minutes, with the aim of providing a smoother approval process.

title: Dubai villa building permits for Emiratis now take five working days under self-licensing scheme
summary_ru: 🚧 Разрешения на строительство вилл для эмиратцев в Дубае теперь выдаются за 5 дней 📅 В Дубае за восемь месяцев с февраля по сентябрь 2026 года по инициативе «Самолицензирование вилл для граждан» было одобрено 8 251 транзакция. Время оформления разрешений сократилось на 37,5%, теперь оно занимает пять рабочих дней. Инициатива позволяет аккредитованным инженерным бюро самостоятельно получать разрешения на строительство, что упрощает и ускоряет процесс. После внедрения механизма последующего контроля выявлено и исправлено 36 нарушений.
